title: A part appears unless it is a core charge or its on-hand quantity is zero
refs: SV-8669 (IV spec v10 2026-08-17 Story 2 S2-R1; S2-R2; S2-N1; S2-N2; §3 Key Decisions; Story 2 context note (no dead-stock exclusion)); SV-10380 (negative quantities are listed; 22 Sep 2026)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
  2. ZZAUTOTEST parts exist at your active location: a normal part with positive on-hand quantity, a core-charge part with a positive quantity, a part with exactly zero on-hand quantity, and a part with a negative on-hand quantity (its bins add up to less than zero).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Inventory Value report scoped to the location.
  2. Look for the normal in-stock part.
  3. Search for the core-charge part, the zero-quantity part, and the negative-quantity part by part number; check the totals row.
custom_expected:
1. The normal, positive-quantity, non-core part appears as one row.
  2. The core-charge part is never listed — even with a positive quantity — and its value is not counted in the totals row.
  3. The zero-quantity part is not listed.
  4. The negative-quantity part IS listed, with its quantity and values below zero, and it lowers the totals row. For example, a part 2 units short with a cost of $10.00 shows a quantity of −2 and a cost value of −$20.00.
  5. Only core-charge parts and parts whose on-hand quantity is exactly zero are left out.
  6. A part that has sat without movement for a long time still appears and is still counted — there is no dead-stock exclusion; how long stock has sat makes no difference.

This is the expected behaviour as per:

  • epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026;
  • the Inventory Value report specification version 10 (S2-R1, S2-R2, S2-N1, S2-N2), read on 17 August 2026;
  • ticket SV-10380, read on 16 November 2026.

Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026, before the negative-quantity change; point 4 has not yet been checked against a build since this update.

The specification (S2-R1) says only quantities greater than zero are valued. The later ticket SV-10380 (22 September 2026) says "Include negative-quantity parts with their signed values", and this case follows that later ticket.

AUTOMATION: READY
